rca of the issue: Apply.jsx Pydantic-422 crash: FastAPI's RequestValidationError returns `detail: [{type, loc, msg, input, ctx, url}, ...]`. Apply.jsx submit catch block passes `e.response.data.detail` straight to `toast.error()` (and Sonner renders it as React children). React refuses to render an array of plain objects. Mitigation: `const d = e?.response?.data?.detail; toast.error(Array.isArray(d) ? d.map(x => x.msg).join('; ') : (d || 'Could not submit. Try again.'));`. Same pattern should be audited across other forms (Settings invites, EmailHealth test-send) but those endpoints currently return string detail so are not affected.
